textContent.text: Weasel and Goose head home after a fun day at the pool.
"This heat makes me want something cold to eat," says Goose.
"Do you want to know how to make the best treat?" Weasel asks. "It's called an ice cream float."
Goose nods.
Weasel says, "My dad showed me how to make one all on my own!" He grabs ice cream and root beer to make a float. He adds both to a glass.
"Try it and tell me what you think," Weasel says.
Goose takes a sip, then scrunches up her face. "Too fizzy for me," she says. Goose scoops ice cream into a bowl and grabs a spoon. "I can't lie," she says. "I like just the ice cream alone."

They follow the trail and peek behind a door.
"Juno!" Drew exclaims. The scruffy dog bolts past them, and the pie drops out of its mouth.
"Now I know I must hide my pies," Drew sighs.
